summary: Solo male hiker summited Mt. Sneffels early Friday afternoon and fell roughly 1,000 ft while descending; OMRT searched Friday evening and spotted the body around 7 a.m. Saturday in the "No Man's Land" area off the descent route.
location: Mt. Sneffels, southwest ridge ("No Man's Land")
